newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kim says need to boost infotech industry.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kim says need to boost infotech industry.

text.p: South Korea's President Kim Young-sam on Monday reaffirmed plans to boost the domestic information and technology industry to enhance the nation's competitive edge on the global market, the information and communications ministry said.

"The information and communications industry will be fostered as a leading industry of the 21st century," Yonhap news agency quoted Kim as telling a meeting of government ministers, business leaders and academics.
"Enhancing information technology is the most important and potent way to sharpen the country's competitiveness," he said.
